## Adult sources

::: warning Adult content
23 sources serve adult content. They are all in this section. MeManga does not hide or filter them.

- **Desktop app:** the default selection includes none of them. The **Sources** page does not mark adult sources, so check this list before you turn a source on.
- **Command line:** while [`sources.disabled`](./config#sources-disabled) is missing, `memanga search` asks the default selection and the sources in your library. A saved list turns off only the sources on it, so an empty list asks every source that is included in search, and that includes `bluesolo.org`, `dynasty-scans.com`, `e-hentai.org`, `furyosociety.com`, `hentai20.io`, `hentaifox.com`, `hentairead.com`, `imhentai.xxx`, `inventariooculto.com`, `lelscanfr.com`, `mangahome.com`, `mangarw.com`, `mangavault.lat`, `manytoon.com`, `nhentai.net`, `noranofansub.com`, `punkrecordz.com`, `rakuentranslations.com`, `rawkuma.net`, `rawuwu.net`. Use `memanga search --source DOMAIN` to ask one source only.
:::
